content.short: MarsNext is a community-centric, fully decentralised reward distribution protocol.
content.description: MarsNext is a community-centric, fully decentralized reward distribution protocol that recognizes and rewards constructive community contributions while raising awareness for upcoming web3 projects. It aims to nurture and amplify vibrant communities around new initiatives by aligning incentives with meaningful participation. The system supports DeFi DApps across Polygon, Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Solana, and OP Mainnet, enabling cross-chain collaboration and broader reach for early-stage projects.
